SkipIntro.description: Skip the opening logos and intro.
SkipPressAnyKey.description: Skip the prompt after loading a level.
InternalResolutionX.description: Set both dimensions to enable a separate internal resolution. Takes effect when the display mode is changed or the game is restarted.
InternalResolutionY.description: Set both dimensions to enable a separate internal resolution. Takes effect when the display mode is changed or the game is restarted.
VSync.description: Synchronize presentation to the display. Takes effect when the display mode is changed or the game is restarted.
MaxFrameRate.description: 0 is uncapped, 1 uses the display refresh rate, otherwise the limit is 10–1000 FPS.
AnisotropicFiltering.description: 0 disables the override; values 2–16 set the filtering level.
LODDistance.description: Multiply the distance at which meshes change detail or disappear.
ShadowMapSize.description: 0 uses the game setting; other values are rounded up to a power of two from 256 to 4096. Takes effect when the display mode is changed or the game is restarted.
FieldOfView.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees; scopes and cutscenes are unaffected.
NoWaypointMarker.description: Hide world markers pointing at objectives.
